integrity: Proof is self-contained using local degree characterization, labeled-forest exponential formula and spanning-tree exchange. Reproducibility C++17 verifier exhaustively checks ordinary forcing through n=7 and exchange through n=6. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary zero forcing on triangular graphs only; the known scalar zero forcing number is prior work. The asserted additional contributions are the full forcing-set forest criterion, polynomial, optimal-set count/classification, exchange connectivity and cross-fibre edge count. No general Johnson-graph or exact exchange-diameter claim. Global historical completeness is unproved.
title: Isolated-forest zero forcing and exchange connectivity of triangular graphs
